purpose: Original genus-level stylized fossil-form candidate, not an exact specimen replica. Private maker stage; publication requires independent acceptance and separate authorization.
coverage_justification: Full 24-frame azimuth orbit plus six canonical, hero/reversehero, clay/alternate key, wire and fold/sulcus detail. Extra full-angle coverage retained rather than relaxing anatomy checks.

scale.basis: Approximate PRI 76796 catalogue width. Not an exact measurement.
scale.length_and_depth: Artistic estimates, preserve deep broad barrel-like volume.

criteria.description: Source/export manifoldness, official validator, reproducibility, scale, budgets and completeness.
Open and inspect every exact-GLB required view for fold, sulcus, shoulder/hinge profile, seam, lighting and facet quality.
Compare named PRI references and explicit limits. No hidden anatomy asserted as measured fact.
Original inventory identity, deliverables, brief constraints and provenance.
Load exact GLB with pinned Three.js 0.180.0 GLTFLoader.
Actual target WebGL render; no inference from parser or Blender renders.
Actual populated intended scene render and measured work.

feature_obligations: Deep broad biconvex barrel-like shell, not flat scallop or generic lentil.
Pronounced median dorsal fold with opposing ventral sulcus, readable in front, top and bottom views.
Short broad hinge, rounded lateral shoulders and radiating simplified costae.
Continuous closed commissure follows central fold/sulcus without a giant aperture.
Metric approximate width 40 mm; hidden rear/depth/palette labeled artistic.
No source mesh, photo texture or UMMP image incorporated.
revision_note: Original feature requirements unchanged; upper valve monotone dome removes artificial posterior focus depression, and rib relief converges to a narrow closed seam.
delivery_contract_freeze_note: Final source checksum bound after build. No feature, scale or material requirement changed; full legacy view coverage retained.
